title: Arabella
lyrics:
[00:20.42]Arabella's got some interstellagator-skin boots
[00:25.04]And a helter skelter around her little finger
[00:27.84]And I ride it endlessly
[00:31.49]She's got a Barbarella silver swimsuit
[00:35.64]And when she needs to shelter from reality
[00:38.34]She takes a dip in my daydreams
[00:43.65]My days end best when the sunset gets itself behind
[00:49.68]That little lady sitting on the passenger side
[00:55.05]It's much less picturesque without her catching the light
[01:00.30]The horizon tries, but it's just not as kind on the eyes
[01:08.22]As Arabella, oh
[01:13.57]As Arabella
[01:15.03]Just might've tapped into your mind and soul
[01:20.47]You can't be sure
[01:35.59]Arabella's got a '70s head
[01:39.61]But she's a modern lover
[01:41.18]It's an exploration, she's made of outer space
[01:46.33]And her lips are like the galaxy's edge
[01:50.29]And a kiss the colour of a constellation
[01:53.43]Falling into place
[01:58.34]My days end best when the sunset gets itself behind
[02:04.46]That little lady sitting on the passenger side
[02:09.89]It's much less picturesque without her catching the light
[02:15.07]The horizon tries, but it's just not as kind on the eyes
[02:22.91]As Arabella, oh
[02:28.21]As Arabella
[02:29.70]Just might've tapped into your mind and soul
[02:35.31]You can't be sure
[02:40.40](That's magic) In a cheetah print coat
[02:43.07](Just a slip) Underneath it, I hope
[02:45.79](Asking if) I can have one of those
[02:48.51](Organic) Cigarettes that she smokes
[02:51.05](Wraps her lips) 'Round a Mexican Coke
[02:53.74](Makes you wish) That you were the bottle
[02:56.32](Takes a sip) Of your soul and it sounds like
[03:13.62]Just might've tapped into your mind and soul
[03:19.45]You can't be sure
